name: coding-onboarding
description: Onboarding for people new to coding or to AI-assisted coding, starting from nothing installed: a curl-able bootstrap installer (install.sh) that sets up Claude Code itself and opens an always-on-top browser checklist, then getting-started (idempotent machine setup — mise toolchain, VS Code, Docker, GitHub, Playwright, plugins, beginner-safe Claude config, Git orientation; macOS, Linux, WSL2; teaches each tool in plain words) and starting-a-project (a 'what are you building?' stack decision tree — Astro, React + Vite/Next.js, Rails/Django, FastAPI, Python + uv, Expo, Streamlit — each with a scaffold command and deploy target, plus a static-site-to-containers deploy guide).
